question: Should OpenClaw expose a public reset-start prompt customization contract, and if yes what key shape, precedence, and replacement-vs-append semantics should it use?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear, but the fix creates a durable config contract in a session-state path and must preserve or intentionally change bootstrap/current-time/reset-greeting invariants.

options.title: Approve scoped prompt customization
options.body: Add one canonical global and per-agent reset prompt policy with fallback, bootstrap/current-time behavior, docs, and regression tests.

options.title: Fold into broader reset policy
options.body: Keep this issue open but resolve it as part of the broader reset greeting/model/suppression policy so one config shape covers all reset-start modes.

options.title: Reject prompt customization
options.body: Keep reset prompt text owned by core and solve the reported UX through startupContext, reset greeting mode, hooks, or docs instead.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped prompt customization
recommendation.body: Add one canonical global and per-agent reset prompt policy with fallback, bootstrap/current-time behavior, docs, and regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest current routing candidate from recent reset-contract history and prior reset-start review comments.
